Recruit NLP Research Team
Six experienced NLP researchers
Over one hour effort per question

Define 5 Core Categories
Advanced reasoning, disambiguation, temporal
Cross-lingual search and false-premise

Draft Unique-Answer Items
Author precise single-answer queries
Unambiguous ground-truth verification

Attach Sources & Evidence
Pair supporting web URLs and rationale
Annotate expected search behaviors

Annotate Freshness Tags
Assign dynamic freshness and review dates
Effective year metadata tags

Frontier Model Failure Filter
Repeatedly test against frontier LLMs
Iterate until all tested agents fail

Peer Cross-Review Rounds
At least two graduate researchers inspect
Verify link validity, correctness & clarity

Expert Approval & Scheduling
Final verification by senior domain expert
Schedule recurring freshness re-checks

Seal-0 Benchmark Subset
111 questions with 0% frontier accuracy
Strict zero-baseline test pool

Seal-Hard Benchmark Suite
254 challenging web-agent questions
Gold supporting URLs and explanations

LongSeal Document Distractors
Pair each task with 1 gold + 50 hard negatives
Randomize position among 12, 20, or 30 docs

Tool-Enabled Web Mode
Agent autonomously issues search queries
Browses live web pages and extracts clues

Search-Injected Mode
Directly inject retrieved snippets
Evaluate reasoning over noisy evidence

LongSeal Context Packaging
Shuffle gold document among distractor set
Evaluate long-context retrieval robustness

Agent Execution & Answer Generation
Run model under configured evaluation mode
Produce final deterministic response

GPT-4o-mini Grader & Reporting
Label correct, incorrect, or not attempted
Report overall accuracy & category breakdowns
